title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Juan in the Municipality of Mabini, Province of Batangas
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of San Juan in the Municipality of Mabini, Province of Batangas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_212_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Nag-ilong and Lugay in the barrio of Mainaga, municipality of Mabini, Province of Batangas, are hereby segregated from the said barrio and constituted into an independent barrio to be known as the barrio of San Juan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 1, 1948.
